metadata.article_title: Service on agent in charge in suits for immovable property.

article.title: Service on agent in charge in suits for immovable property.
article.content: Where in a suit to obtain relief respecting, or compensation for wrong to, immovable property, service cannot be made on the defendant in person, and the defendant has no agent empowered to accept the service, it may be made on any agent of the defendant in charge of the property.
article.html:
14Service on agent in charge in suits for immovable property.

Order 5, Rule 14

Where in a suit to obtain relief respecting, or compensation for wrong to, immovable property, service cannot be made on the defendant in person, and the defendant has no agent empowered to accept the service, it may be made on any agent of the defendant in charge of the property.
